description: Points d'Eau Incendie du département de l'Hérault is a dataset listed in Hérault Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Service Départemental d'Incendie et de Secours de l'Hérault (SDIS34). Liste des Points d'Eau Incendie (PEI) du département de l'Hérault. L'exhaustivité des données n'est pas garantie. Le SDIS34 est en charge de la maintenance de la base de données départementale pour la Défense Extérieure Contre l'Incendie (DECI), la production des informations relève de la compétence des collectivités territoriales. Coverage: Hérault. The portal files it under Territoires, Agriculture et Innovations. Its keywords are deci, hydrant, incendie, pei, sdis, sdis34. The portal shows 19,294 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-herault-data-fr-portal.
